meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂目标拆解成有依据的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂目标不知如何拆分
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex goals into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to break down complex goals

howto.what: Claude 会把你的目标拆成许多带验证证据的小步骤，用内部清单跟踪进度，并把代码修改、测试和 QA 交给后台子代理，自己负责协调和记录。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”“ulw”等关键词，或要求以证据为导向的工作时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我拆解这个任务，并给出每步的验证证据。
say.note: Claude 会先注册目标再按循环执行。

say.text: 以证据导向的方式执行：每完成一小步都给我看实际产出。
say.note: 它会用 CLI 记录状态并要求真实表面的证据。

say.text: 启动 ulw 长期交付，按停止规则做手动 QA。
say.note: 它会先读工作流文档再开始分阶段运行。

howto.what_en: Claude breaks the goal into small, evidence-bound steps, tracks progress with CLI state under .omo/ulw-loop, and delegates code edits, tests, and QA to subagents while coordinating and checking results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says keywords like "ulw-loop"/"ulw", or asks for durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to decompose this task and give evidence for each step.
say_en.note: It registers the goal first, then runs the loop.

say_en.text: Run in evidence-led mode: show real output after each small step.
say_en.note: It records state via CLI and requires observable evidence.

say_en.text: Start a ulw long-running delivery and do manual QA per stop rules.
say_en.note: It reads the workflow docs before phased execution.
